scope: W2 song pages (/artists/<artist-id>/<slug>/) for all 23 catalogue tracks, and the credit added to make an existing song page complete.

decisions.approved: 2026-11-09, user (relayed by the planning session): prototype layout, slug rule, strict index rule, romance-youth-love and the HANRORO credit line.
decisions.slugRule: Official English title in lowercase ASCII words joined by hyphens; apostrophes and featuring credits dropped; RomanceYouthLove is split into romance-youth-love. Stored explicitly as tracks[].slug; unique within an artist.
decisions.indexRule: A song page is indexed only with credits, an Apple Music release link, a background note with a cited source (extraSources or lyricNotes.backgroundSources) and lyric notes. Otherwise it is noindex and outside the sitemap, and the artist page keeps the full song section. The rule lives in scripts/song-pages.mjs; run `node scripts/song-pages.mjs` for the current status of every song.
